svg.title: Original synthetic returned work — two parallel branches
svg.desc: A 12 volt source spans two branch resistors of 6 and 3 ohms. Fictional student writes each gets 3 amps. Fictional red marking asks which nodes each resistor connects to. This is authored development material.

g.text: Find the currents in the two ideal parallel branches.
“Each branch gets 3 A because parallel means equal current.”
Which nodes does each resistor connect to?
Authored annotation, not actual instructor feedback. No real student data.
